saw_lines: Shoppers in multi-brand fashion stores compare several brands in one visit, then decide on price and fit, not the brand story.
So the sale is lost in the ad, when a shopper finds no price or delivery answer and moves on.
Your site offers 10% off, yet 0 of 6 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 10% off in line one of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off, yet 0 of 6 ads mention it or any offer, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 10% off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

Your site answers how delivery works, yet 0 of 25 ads mention shipping, so new buyers must leave to find the cost. Open ads for them with the shipping answer and the €69 free shipping threshold in line one.
One exact copy runs in 3 of 6 ads, so the same message repeats across placements and buyers see one story twice. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each of the three.
0 of 6 ads with fixed copy carry a proof number, so buyers have no reason to trust you yet. Collect one number, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead one ad with it on the creative.

ads_1: Open new ads with 10% off and the €69 free shipping line.
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and YouTube
